title: First Final Fantasy Resonance PS5 Review Precedes GTA6 Launch
description: As we approach the GTA6 launch next month, the first review for Square Enix's HD-2D RPG Final Fantasy Resonance has been published by Famitsu.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Heavy Release Schedule Heats Up

The heavy release schedule continues in earnest, and while we are approaching the endgame for this year with GTA 6 next month, there is plenty of enthusiasm for Square Enix's upcoming HD-2D effort, Final Fantasy Resonance.

## First Review and Campaign Length Revealed

Now, ahead of its release on 22nd October next week, Famitsu has published the throwback RPG's first review – and it’s a good one. This positive early reception from such a prominent outlet provides a strong vote of confidence for fans of classic-style role-playing games looking for a fresh yet nostalgic experience on the PS5.

## Looking Ahead to Release Week

As the gaming community counts down the days to major autumn blockbusters, titles like Final Fantasy Resonance are carving out their own space in a packed release calendar. With the launch just around the corner, players won't have to wait much longer to dive into this new HD-2D adventure.

## Editor's Take

While the shadow of GTA 6 looms large over the entire industry right now, it's refreshing to see unique projects like Final Fantasy Resonance capturing the spotlight. This positive opening review proves that there is still massive appetite for diverse gaming experiences this season.
